purpose: Unweighted cross-sectional predictive feasibility benchmark; not population inference or clinical validation
cohort: Adults >=18 with reliable day-one recall and positive measured TSH, Free T3 and Free T4; no outcome-based trimming
selection: Five fixed folds within development; minimize equally weighted standardized outcome MSE
preprocessing: SEQN joins within cycle; reliable recall days averaged by participant; separate physical nutrient units; development-fold median imputation and standardization only
test_policy: Persist membership before model fitting. Evaluate locked 20 percent once. Existing output blocks rerunning evaluation.
release_gate: Joint dietary/thyroid sample weighting, clinical eligibility, confounding, model calibration and external validation not reviewed. Artifact is research-only and not consumed by serving clients.
